_about: The glossary's pictures (docs/GLOSSARY-PLUS.md). New pictures by Meta's Muse Image (muse-image-1.0), made once by agent/glossary_pictures.py with the references below; reused ones are the cast's (web/cast/cast.json). On a teaching fab of our own and the SMT2020 testbed; not a real fab.

SMT2020.prompt:
Three reference images are attached: a scene from this cartoon world, a machine from its cast (a polishing-machine robot that trains like a gym-goer) and a lot from its cast (a grey wafer carrier with a friendly face, a stack of rainbow wafers inside, red wristbands). Draw ONE small square illustration in exactly their cartoon style and palette: hand-inked comic, bold clean black outlines of one even weight, flat cel colour with a single shade tone, a little cross-hatching, cute and expressive, chunky simple shapes. Colours from the cast: off-white and light grey, mint green, amber, the cast's red sweatbands, and the rainbow shimmer of wafers. Plain flat white background with only a soft grey oval shadow, like the cast's tiles. One clear idea, easy to read at a small size. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos or brand names anywhere; any sign, card or screen is blank.

The picture shows: a big open recipe book on a lectern, its pages showing tiny drawings of machines joined by arrows; a wafer carrier reads it closely through a magnifying glass.
